name: strength-max-set-back-squat
description: A strength block that finishes on a max-rep set at a lighter load ('Back Squat — 4 sets x 5 reps @~80%, + max reps @60%'). The board writes four sets and the athlete earns the fifth, so gpt-5.5 leaves suggestedRepsPerSet null and stamps isMaxReps on a SECOND Back Squat row. Three of the four places that asked 'does this block have a max set' keyed off that rep array, so the screen collected the max and the save path dropped it. The doc below is what logging writes now: four written sets, then set 5 carrying isMax with the athlete's own count and the lighter bar — captured by running the real save path, breakdown included. KNOWN GAP, deliberately snapshotted as-is: the poster does NOT yet print that set. Its prescription maps are keyed by movement NAME, so the board's two Back Squat lines collapse onto one key — the max row loses its stamp to the working row and prints as a duplicate. Rendering 'Max Back Squat — 14 @ 60kg' off sets[].isMax is the open half of this fix.
